data.title: Electricity contract confirmation – Ökostrom Fix 12
data.summary: Beispiel Energie AG confirms an electricity supply contract (tariff "Ökostrom Fix 12") starting 1 January 2026, with a 12-month initial term and a monthly advance payment of €78.00.
data.explanation: This letter confirms your new electricity contract. Supply starts on 1 January 2026 and the provider handles the switch from your old supplier. The initial term is 12 months. To end the contract at the end of that term, you must give one month's notice. After that, it continues indefinitely and can be cancelled at any time with one month's notice. You pay a monthly advance payment (Abschlag) of €78.00. The app calculates the cancellation deadline from the contract terms.
